verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents its own soundbite creation through its first-party MCP server (`fireflies_create_soundbite` creates a soundbite clip from a meeting transcript), and its MCP tools overview confirms tools can create soundbites. The documented sharing tool shares whole meeting transcripts, not individual clips, so sharing just that moment is unevidenced. missing for 10: documented in-app UI for cutting highlight clips, evidence that a soundbite can be shared on its own (link or recipient sharing) instead of the full recording, independent or hands-on corroboration.
